tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Window/page ground — the lightest step of the warm-paper ladder (graphite in dark). Body text is `color-ink` on it.

tokens.name: color-background-accent
tokens.usage: A half-step below `color-background`; settings and secondary page grounds.

tokens.name: color-panel
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, dialogs, menus, popovers, inputs. The most-used surface after the page ground.

tokens.name: color-panel-warm
tokens.usage: Warmer recessed panel for grouped content, status rows and nested sections.

tokens.name: color-panel-code
tokens.usage: Inline code and diff surfaces inside light chrome.

tokens.name: color-panel-result
tokens.usage: Tool-result blocks in the chat stream.

tokens.name: color-panel-user
tokens.usage: The user's own message bubble in the chat stream.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface. Neutral gray-12 in paper, warm cream in onedark.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, placeholders, menu labels. 4.5:1+ on `color-background` and `color-panel` in both themes.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Violet: Isoform did, is doing or is saying something. Brand highlight — labels, emphasis, secondary actions. A deep warm gray, not a hue; also the selected day in Calendar.

tokens.name: color-accent-light
tokens.usage: 10% tint of `color-accent` for soft highlighted fills. Defined; no direct use found.

tokens.name: color-accent-2

tokens.name: color-accent-2-light

spacing.note: The code defines no spacing scale of its own; it uses Tailwind v4's 4px base unit (p-1 = 4px … p-10 = 40px).

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Tailwind base unit; every p-/m-/gap- step is a multiple. Common: 6px (1.5) menu rows, 12px (3) menu item x-padding, 24px (6) Dialog/Sheet padding, 40px (10) hero Card padding.

radius.note: Tailwind v4 default radii, as the components use them.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: `rounded` — Checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: `rounded-md` — menu items, Calendar days, inner list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: `rounded-lg` — Select trigger, Combobox content, context menu, small and icon Buttons, Sheet close.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: `rounded-xl` — Card, Dialog, Command palette, dropdown/Select/Popover content, Textarea.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: `rounded-full` — default and large Buttons (pills), ghost Button, Switch, Avatar.
